messages:
Ava: heads-up — after-hours demo sprint tomorrow 6pm PT. Need reg page, Zoom setup (cloud recording + fallback), post-event edit + lead routing. 45m demo + 15m Q&A.
Sam: got it. I can own run-of-show & greenroom. who takes reg page copy/CTAs?
Maya: Ill draft reg copy. Thinking 2 CTAs: "Register" + "Get reminder & resources". A/B subject lines for reminders.
Luis: Zoom ops recs: enable cloud recording (host only), set retention 30d, waiting room on. RTMP fallback to OBS -> S3 if cloud fails.
Ava: dont require auth (maximize signups). Keep waiting room on. Luis, can you add RTMP fallback runbook snippet?
Luis: yes — snippet: ```bash
# RTMP fallback (OBS)
obs --startstream --rtmp-url rtmp://s3-fallback.example.com/live/KEY
# Lambda watches for missing cloud recording then copies RTMP file to recordings-bucket
```
Sam: recording ownership: Sam 48h first cut, Maya highlight clips, Luis uploads raw + transcription to GDrive + S3.
Maya: clips: 2x60s social + 1x5m teaser. Ill do nurture messaging. Need speaker names + headshots by EOD.
Ava: speakers: Priya, Chen, Marco — will ping. Add UTM params + hidden field demo_interest on reg form.
Maya: lead routing logic: demo_interest==enterprise -> Salesforce owner queue; pilot/blank -> marketing nurture.
ZapierBot: webhook created: https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/abc123/... Mapping: email, name, utm_source, demo_interest, company, job_title.
Sam: run-of-show: 17:45 greenroom open, 18:00 start, 18:45 Q&A, 19:00 end. Luis: ping healthcheck RTMP 10m before.
Luis: added lambda to generate VTT, speaker diarization tags, and upload artifacts. Will set recording retention.
Ava: CTA options drafted: A: "Save my spot & get the demo replay" B: "Register for live demo + materials". Maya to A/B.
Maya: reminder cadence: 48h, 2h, 10m. SMS opt-in if provided. Nurture: Day 1 replay + highlights, Day 3 deep-dive w/ CTA to request pilot.
Sam: post-event owners recap: Sam=edit, Luis=raw+transcripts, Maya=clips+nurture, Ava=speaker comms/replay approval.
Ava: confirm owners & blockers by 4pm. Ill loop in speakers after. :thumbsup:
Luis: confirmed. No infra blockers.
Maya: confirmed. CTA variants up by 3pm.
Sam: confirmed. Will post run-of-show + greenroom link here before EOD.
Ava: thanks team!
